title: refactor: merge duplicate ClientCertStore/ClientCertEntry (reader→stoa-auth)
description:
## Why
ClientCertStore and ClientCertEntry are duplicated between crates/reader/src/store/client_cert_store.rs and crates/auth/src/client_cert_store.rs (same situation as CredentialStore before stoa-526bc4c6). Reader uses its own local copy; stoa-auth has the canonical copy. These must be consolidated before they drift further.

## What needs to be done
Same pattern as stoa-526bc4c6:
1. Re-export stoa_auth::ClientCertEntry from crates/reader/src/config.rs (replacing local definition).
2. Delete crates/reader/src/store/client_cert_store.rs.
3. Update all reader call sites to use stoa_auth::ClientCertStore.

## Found by
SEC1 review of stoa-526bc4c6 (stoa-45f3f588.5).
